units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 6:29">Targ. Jud. VI, 29</cite> (h. text <cite ref="B01148"><he>בקש</he></cite>); a. fr.—
Ber. 2ᵇ ובעו לה מבעיא האי וכ׳ and put it as a question (not as an argument), Does this uba hash-shemesh mean &c.? (opposed to preceding וממאי דהאי וכ׳ how can it be proven that &c.).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Challah 1:1:13">Y. Ḥall. I, 57ᵇ</cite> <he>רבנן … בעיין</he> the Rabbis of … asked.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 33a:23">B. Kam. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>בעא</he> … <he>מרב וכ׳</he> R. asked R. N.; a. v. fr.

senses.gloss: to ask, pray, frequ. ב׳ רחמין to ask for mercy, pray.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 12:13">Targ. Y. Num. XII, 13</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 8a:14">Ber. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>לבעי אינש רחמי</he> man should pray &c., v. <cite ref="G00266"><he>זיבולא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 10a:3">Ib. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>בְּעִי רחמי עלויהו וכ׳</he> pray thou for them that they may repent; a. fr.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 2:15">Targ. Ex. II, 15</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Pesachim 9a:2">Pes. 9ᵃ</cite> <he>ובָעֵי בדיקה</he> and it (the house) requires searching over again.
<cite ref="Ketubot 39b:10">Keth. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>לא בעינא לך</he> I do not want thee.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 102b:19">B. Kam. 102ᵇ</cite> <he>לא יקרייכו בעינא וכ׳</he> I want neither your honor nor your disrespect; a. fr.—
Pes. 2ᵃ בעו שבוחי must give praise.—אי בעית אימא, usu. איבעית אימא, v. אִיבָּעִית. [Y. Yeb. XII, 13ᵃ top בְּעֵא תתן לנו, please, give us.]

senses.gloss: (ellipt.) to beg leave to say; to remark, assert.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1:8">Y. Ber. I, 2ᵇ</cite> top.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 2:1:5">Y. Peah II, beg. 16ᵈ</cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be searched for, to be wanted.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 50:20">Targ. Jer. L, 20</cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 23:26">Targ. I Sam. XXIII, 26</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 4:4">Targ. II Sam. IV, 4</cite> <he>בְּאִתְבָּעֲיוּתָהּ</he> when she was hurried; v. <cite ref="B01058"><he>בְּעַע</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 4b">Pes. 4ᵇ</cite>, a. v. fr. <he>אִיבָּעְיָא להו</he> it was asked by them (the scholars), i.e. the argument came up.

senses.gloss: to be required; it ought to. Ib. 7ᵇ יצא בו מיבעי ליה it ought to read yatsa bo (he has done his duty). Ib. 15ᵃ מדבריו מ׳ ליה it ought to be midd’barav (not middibrehem); a. fr.—
units: B. Kam. 21ᵇ א׳ ליה לאסוקי דעתא he ought to have borne in mind; a. fr.—לא מיבעיא there is no question. לא מ׳ … אלא אפילו there is no question as to …, but even …; not only … but.

<cite ref="Pesachim 4b">Pes. 4ᵇ</cite> <he>לא מ׳ באתרא … אלא וכ׳</he> not only in a place where they pay no wages for searching, but do it themselves, (is there no cause for withdrawing from the agreement,) because a man likes to perform a religious duty: but even in a place where they pay wages, (there is no cause &c.,) for a man likes &c.
B. Kam. 54ᵇ לא מ׳ קאמר לא מ׳ שור וכ׳ the Mishnah states a case of ‘not only’; not only for an ox … is he responsible, but even &c.; a. v. fr.—מִיבָּעְיָא is there any question?; v. הַשְׁתָּא.

senses.gloss: to let burst forth, v. יְעָא a. נְבַע.
